column1: # MI1 (DUMB Korean VGA patch), U preset: 2 bpp, alpha=true in M1KOU.MAP.
# Fields: output 8.3 name, SCUMM charset, TTF, size, bpp, ascent.
# Size and ascent are what mkfont.py --fit-cell picks for the charset's cell over the
# scanned game text (the U rows of m5_sheets.py, +0 variant, which never clips):
# The card size is small because four stray symbols in the noisy scummtext.py scan
# (U+3389 U+339C U+33BD U+33BF) do not fit any larger size; see the Task 9 report.
# Charset 3 has the same 16x16 cell as charset 1: one file serves both (see M1KOU.MAP).
# The TTF field starts with $FONTS (default ~/scummvm-i18n/fonts; set FONTS=... to move it).
